title: Good in theory, sadly failure in application.
text: Good in theory, sadly failure in application.. Slides everywhere especially the tray as there's no place to latch it. I ended up ordering a microfiber mat to replace the tray and know you use inside space for silverware attachment so if you don't want clean items in silverware attachment to get splashback from the sink because up need to hand over the edge of sink, large or small spaces, there's no drip tray catch if you move to other end on outside to save room.  Fail.
